projectsDir.description: Folder with one subfolder per project holding <name>/<name>.md. Relative to the config file; ~ is the home folder.

reposDir.description: Folder where project repos are cloned; a repo is matched by folder name unless the card sets repo.

transcriptsDir.description: Claude Code transcripts for the time split.

dbFile.description: SQLite file for uptime history and the digest log.

port.description: PORT in .env.local or the environment wins.

utcOffset.description: Time zone of card times and of the digest day. Defaults to the computer's offset at start.

ignore.description: Words; a project whose name or repo path contains one is never probed and its repo and transcripts are never read.

reviewAgents.description: Claude Code subagent types counted as review time.

command.description: Command that sends the digest; the text is appended as the last argument. Overrides Telegram.
